meta.name: remote-collection
meta.description: Configure and troubleshoot CCAM Remote Data Sources that collect Claude Code and Codex history over SSH. Use when adding, editing, testing, syncing, or removing a remote machine, verifying provider paths, or deciding whether to retain or purge imported sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并排查远程数据源,同步与管理编码会话历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在多台机器上编程并希望集中管理 AI 编码会话记录
copy.tagline_en: Configure remote data sources to collect and manage coding history over SSH.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code on several machines and want to consolidate your AI coding session history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 CCAM 远程数据源：列出所有来源、通过 SSH 验证主机、添加/编辑/测试/同步/删除远程机器，并在删除前说明导入数据是保留还是清除。
howto.when: 当你提出添加、编辑、测试、同步或删除远程机器，或验证提供者路径、决定保留或清除导入会话时触发。

say.text: 帮我列出当前的远程数据源。
say.note: 执行 ccam remote-sources 命令。

say.text: 添加一个远程主机，指定 remote_home 路径。
say.note: 用现有 SSH 配置验证主机后添加。

say.text: 删除这个远程源并清除导入的数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage CCAM remote data sources: list all sources, validate hosts over SSH, add/edit/test/sync/remove remote machines, and state whether imported data will be kept or purged before removal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add, edit, test, sync, or remove a remote machine, verify provider paths, or decide whether to retain or purge imported sessions.

say_en.text: List my current remote data sources.
Add a remote host with remote_home set.
say_en.note: Uses existing SSH config to validate host.

say_en.text: Delete this remote source and purge imported data.
